The last version of the original Python app, for **Windows 10/11**. It has been replaced by [Shift Paste 2.0](https://github.com/infinityhardik/shiftPaste/releases/tag/v2.0.0), which is faster, lighter and also runs on macOS and Linux.

**Features**
- Clipboard history, captured automatically and de-duplicated.
- Sequential search: letters match in order (`1884` finds “18 mm 8 x 4”).
- Master files: keep frequently used snippets in Excel files, indexed automatically.
- `Ctrl+Shift+V` opens it next to your cursor; arrow keys and Enter to paste.
- Results ranked by recency and match quality.
- Skips password-manager content; the hotkey can be turned off in chosen apps.

**Downloads**
- `ShiftPaste-1.1.0-Setup.exe`: Windows installer with shortcuts.
- `ShiftPaste-1.1.0-portable.exe`: single file, no installation; just run it.

The files aren't code-signed, so Windows may say “Windows protected your PC”: click *More info → Run anyway*.
